brief: marketActive() is `isMarketDay() && hour >= 8 && hour < 17` and the draw list consults it directly (`if (marketActive()) for (const s of MARKET_STALLS) items.push(...)`, ~line 2328). So at hour 8 three fully-built stalls appear between two frames, and at 17 they vanish the same way. It is the largest single pop in the town and it happens every fourth day. Give market day a beginning and an end: traders arrive and put the stalls up before opening, and pack down after. Mind the compression — hour 8 to 17 is about 20 s of real time, so a setup has roughly 2 s to happen in and still read as an event.
successLooksLike: On a market morning you can watch the market being built and in the evening watch it go, and no filmstrip frame shows three stalls arriving at once.
avoid: Do not add a fourth stall or a new stall type. Do not move marketActive()'s hours — laneRate multiplies by 1.7 on it at ~3216 and marketAnnounced reads it at ~3190.
